thread:
nina: quick poll  should required fields show a red asterisk, or visible 'Required' label? accessibility and localization concerns.
ash: visible 'Required' wins for clarity. screen readers handle text better than symbols.
tom: agree, but keep it subtle so it doesn't compete with the primary label. maybe use smaller caps: 'REQUIRED' or titlecase?
ux-bot: a11y scan: small uppercase needs higher contrast. recommend sentence case 'Required' at 3:1 contrast.
ash: good call. next: inline errors vs summary on submit. i'm leaning hybrid  inline on blur, plus a condensed top summary on submit linking to fields.
nina: hybrid sounds right. ensure the top summary anchors focus to the first invalid field without jarring scroll and respect prefers-reduced-motion.
tom: dev note: we'll implement focus like `firstError.focus({preventScroll: true})` then smooth-scroll if motion allowed.
ux-bot: accessibility note: inline errors should be present in DOM and use role="alert" when revealed so AT announces them. avoid announcing per-keystroke to reduce noise.
ash: last item  destructive confirms: typed-confirm for org-level deletes, simple modal + undo for minor deletes. also soft-delete with configurable retention.
nina: copy idea for project delete modal header: "Permanently delete project" body: "Type the project name to confirm. This action cannot be undone." CTA: "Delete project" (danger).
tom: i'll scope tickets for compact + expanded specs and pair with design next week. thanks! :white_check_mark:
